title: Alexander Nix: From Mad Men to Math Men | OMR Festival 2017 - Hamburg, Germany | #OMR17
summary: Cambridge Analytica CEO Alexander Nix keynotes the OMR 2017 marketing festival on big data and personality-based targeting in political campaigns. It was given before the company's scandal broke.
why: HN cites it, often critically, as Nix openly describing data-driven manipulation and targeting methods.

quote.text: Alexander Nix's utterly fascinating OMR presentation
